title: Disabling cellular watch's connection
body:
**Issue A**. The service (or services) of Wear OS disables cellular connection on the watch when the charge of the watch "Huawei Watch 2 LTE" is 15 % less. Cellular connection on the watch is enabled automatically after charging more 15 %. Is there any ways or workarounds to turn this service off forever? As an alternative it would be nice if the cellular data connectivity turned off at just 5 % or less.
**Issue B** (more complicated then A). I use the watch running with jamorham's patched firmware (I see in xDrip+ events log that "DemiGod mode" reports as true) and installed “Nightly build 10th Jan 2019” and "Wear OS 2.2" update. It is just a Wear OS app update, not a system update, because as before I see on the watch that Android OS version is 8.0.0 and Android security patch level from 1st March 2018. Google says just "Wear OS Update H" (which based on Android 9 Pie) adds in several extra features such as improved battery saver and movement detection, so the watch falls into a deep sleep mode after 30 minutes of inactivity. "Wear OS 2.2" is not the same update.
Nevertheless sometimes my watch goes into something like a "deep sleep mode" and loses cellular data connectivity. I see a cloud-with-a-line-through-it icon on the watch screen at those times. It happens when my watch was connected to the phone only via cellular (in other words when the watch does not have bluetooth connection to the phone) and if at the same time there were no movements during 30-60 mins. For example, the watch may be on the shelf not far from my G5 transmitter (in its bluetooth coverage area) but at the same time too far from the phone (out of bluetooth phone range). I noticed that in this case bluetooth watch connection to G5 transmitter works without any flaws, and the watch collects readings successfully. But the watch does not transmit these readings from its collector to the phone via cellular because it is inactive on the watch. These readings are transmitted to the phone via cellular only after I push button of the watch. The cellular battery saver option under developer options of my watch is turned off. I tried to turn this saver on, I did not catch the difference.
Also I noticed that the watch never falls into "deep sleep mode" and always transmits readings from its collector to the phone if it has bluetooth connection to the phone (the watch is in bluetooth range of the phone).
Is there any software or firmware solution for preventing this loss of cellular data сonnection on the watch? Perhaps an easy solution for this would be to allow xDrip+ access to motion sensors and to act on them periodically, thereby simulating the movement of the watch and providing wakelock of cellular data connectivity on the watch to transmit readings to the phone permanently and automatically (without push button of watch to wake it).

comments.body: I'm not clear exactly what this is about. You want to permanently disable the cellular data connection on the Watch? Does it not work to select Cellular Data -> Off in the android settings?

I don't want to disable the cellular data connection on the watch and I don't want to lose the cellular data connection between the watch and the phone through the cloud (Google service) when the watch works as a collector at a long distance from the phone. Loss of cellular data сonnection occurs on the watch in 30-60 mins if the watch is at rest and if at the same time the watch doesn't have bluetooth connection to the phone. For example, the watch may be on the shelf not far from my G5 transmitter (in their bluetooth coverage area - not more then 10-15 meters) but at the same time too far from the phone (e.g. 1 kilometer). In this case readings can not be transmitted from the watch collector to the phone via cellular data connectivity which is inactive on the watch. Cellular data connectivity on the watch was fallen into a “deep sleep mode” by service of Wear OS within 30-60 mins of the watch being at rest.
Jon, sorry for my English.
